en.title: Disney Lorcana's "Attack of the Vine!" Unleashes Iconic Team-Ups
en.summary: The latest Disney Lorcana expansion, "Attack of the Vine!", is set to drop soon, and it's bringing some of the most beloved Disney duos together on the TCG battlefield. Get ready for powerful new cards featuring characters you know and love.
en.body:
Get ready to assemble your ultimate Disney dream team! The highly anticipated **Disney Lorcana TCG** expansion, **"Attack of the Vine!"**, is almost here, and it’s packed with exciting new mechanics and beloved characters. This set introduces a thrilling "team-up" theme, bringing iconic duos from across the Disney and Pixar universes onto powerful new cards. Players can expect to see legendary pairings like **Woody & Buzz Lightyear**, **Pocahontas & Meeko**, **Darkwing Duck & Launchpad**, **Sulley & Boo**, **Peter Pan & Tinker Bell**, and the quintessential Disney couple, **Mickey & Minnie Mouse**, ready to join their lore collections.

These new "Team" cards aren't just for show; they bring unique abilities and strategic depth to the game. Many of these powerful allies come with a high ink cost and are dual-ink, meaning they can only be added to specific decks. This limitation encourages thoughtful deck-building and adds a layer of challenge for players aiming to harness their full potential. For instance, the **Buzz Lightyear** team card has the potential to draw more cards upon play and even cast 2-cost-or-less cards for free when questing – a truly game-changing ability. Similarly, the **Peter Pan & Tinker Bell** card grants all of the owner's characters Evasive, a coveted ability, especially for Amethyst ink decks that frequently rely on evasive strategies.

The **"Attack of the Vine!"** set also showcases innovative ways to utilize the "Shift" mechanic, which allows players to play a Floodborn version of a character by paying its ink cost and revealing a specific character card from their hand. The **Sulley & Boo** team card introduces "Combo Shift," enabling it to shift onto either a Sulley, a Boo, or both simultaneously. Their "The Power of Friendship" ability is particularly noteworthy, as it allows the characters underneath the shifted card to return to the field instead of going to the discard pile, offering incredible board presence. **Mickey & Minnie Mouse** bring "Duo Shift" to the table, requiring both characters to be on the field before they can shift into their powerful team form. These unique shift requirements offer a fresh twist on a mechanic players have already come to love, building upon previous shifts like "Universal Shift" and "Puppy Shift" with more specific, thematic triggers.

## A Celebration of Iconic Pairings

This expansion is a love letter to the enduring appeal of Disney's most memorable characters and their relationships. By focusing on these iconic team-ups, **"Attack of the Vine!"** taps directly into the nostalgia and emotional connection fans have with these stories. The strategic implications of these dual-character cards are immense, pushing players to think about synergy and character placement in new ways. Whether you're a seasoned Lorcana veteran or a newcomer drawn in by the magic of Disney, these powerful new cards offer compelling reasons to dive into the game and explore the strategic possibilities they unlock. The sheer joy of seeing these characters interact on the cards, with abilities that reflect their on-screen dynamics, is a major draw for the community.

## What's Next

Fans eager to get their hands on **"Attack of the Vine!"** can look forward to an early release at local game stores on July 17, with a wide release scheduled for July 24. Additionally, **Disney Lorcana** is hosting "Collection Quest" events on June 27 at select GameStop and EB Games locations, offering an early opportunity to engage with the game and potentially acquire special items.

content_raw: The newest Disney Lorcana expansion set, Attack of the Vine!, is set to have an early release on July 17 at local games stores with a wide release on July 24th. With that said, we’re exclusively revealing six new cards showcasing the set’s new team up theme, Woody & Buzzlightyear, Pocahontas & Meeko, Darkwing Duck & Launchpad, Sulley & Boo, Peter Pan & Tinker Bell, and of course the famous Disney duo themselves, Mickey & Minnie Mouse. Disney Lorcana continues to feature Pixar characters from their introduction last set, but we’re also seeing familiar faces with these new powerful Team cards. Alongside some high ink costs, these team cards are also dual ink which means they can only be added to certain decks. On top of this limitation, the cards can shift from specific characters and there’s only so many characters in certain ink Buzz Lightyear team card can potentially draw more cards on play and also play 2 or less cost cards for free when questing. That’s any card! There’s also the Peter Pan & Tinker Bell card that gives the owner’s characters Evasive, and players know how much Amethyst/Purple love their evasiveness. We also have a glimpse of more unique ways to shift with the team cards Sulley & Boo and Mickey & Minnie Mouse. Sulley & Boo, for example, gets to shift on top of either a Sulley, Boo, or both at the same time with Combo Shift. The reason for this is their ability, The Power of Friendship, which allows the characters underneath the shifted card to return to the field instead of staying in the discard as usual. Mickey & Minnie Mouse also have a new shift called Duo Shift which requires both characters on the field to shift into their powerful team card. We’ve seen different shifts before with Universal Shift and Puppy Shift which had broader requirements, so some of these new additions only cement how powerful these cards can be in the upcoming meta. Disney Lorcana Attack of the Vine! is the 13th set adding new classifications like Team and Vineling alongside further support for older ones like Hunny. Of course, we’ll be graced with even more beautiful full art cards that any Disney fan can adore like the Pocahontas & Meeko card revealed here. As we patiently wait for the release of the upcoming set, be sure to check out our hands-on impressions of the last set, Wilds Unknown , and also our roundup of the Wilds Unknown Special Lorecast earlier this year.
